featured_reviews.name: Vicky Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
The possession was significantly delayed, considering our expectations and the verbal commitments made by the sales team. Constructing and delivering five buildings in five years falls far below industry standards. Notably, surrounding buildings were completed in a much shorter timeframe.

I haven't received the finished flat, and upon closer inspection, numerous flaws in the finishing are evident. Craftsmanship is lacking, with broken tiles in the building passages. In my flat, issues include cracked bathroom granite, improperly flushing WC, numerous broken tiles in the kitchen, a dirty kitchen sink, and mismatched granites on the kitchen platform.

The parking space assigned to me doesn't exist, and parking numbers are incorrect. The most significant issue is that lifts in A and B wings don't reach Basement 2.

I deeply regret purchasing this property from Chandak. In the future, I will opt for a reputable builder and avoid buying anything under construction.
